description.zh: 路由条目的描述。描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en: The description of the route entry. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://.
The ID of the custom route.

description.zh:
路由条目的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the route.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-ens-route-entry --route-entry-id rte-50000 --route-entry-name test --description test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ModifyEnsRouteEntry --region cn-hangzhou --RouteEntryId 'rte-50000' --Description test --RouteEntryName test
